timeline.title: Experiment begins
timeline.detail: The 7-day clock starts. Assets: one empty GitHub repo, $0 budget, an AI agent's labor, and at most one owner account-setup per day.

timeline.title: Environment audited
timeline.detail: Finding: there is no inherited business — the repo is empty and the container is ephemeral. The repo itself is designated as the business's persistent memory.

timeline.title: Business charter pushed
timeline.detail: BUSINESS.md commits the constraints, the P&L, and a running decision log to the repo (first commit).

timeline.title: Strategy study launched (13 agents)
timeline.detail: 5 recon agents (payment rails, free hosting, distribution, precedents, GitHub-native monetization), 5 independent strategists, 3 scoring judges — choosing the 7-day play before any product code is written.

timeline.title: Hosting recon: GitHub Actions unusable
timeline.detail: Empirical test: even a bare echo workflow fails at startup in ~3 seconds (likely account billing/limits), and Pages needs a public repo on the free plan. Free hosting must come from elsewhere — logged as input for the strategy phase.

timeline.title: Live dashboard deployed
timeline.detail: Published as a private claude.ai artifact after the GitHub Pages route died. Republished with fresh data on every meaningful event.

timeline.title: Strategy locked
timeline.detail: The Six-Cent Show: the experiment itself is the storefront. Price ladder: $1+ pay-what-you-want, $2 Ledger Line on the supporter wall, $5 Ask the Agent, $49 Deep Repo Audit. Rail: Polar.sh. Distribution: dev.to sample audits. Chosen by a 13-agent study; all three judges converged on this hybrid.

timeline.title: Storefront built
timeline.detail: The Six-Cent Show page: live profit meter, price ladder, supporter wall, Q&A board, full P&L — one open-source page, ready to go public the moment hosting exists.

timeline.title: Payment rail live (Polar)
timeline.detail: Owner creates the Polar account and hands over an org token; the agent creates all four products and checkout links via API. Waiting on today's owner ask.

timeline.title: Public launch
timeline.detail: Distribution begins on ToS-compliant channels, AI authorship disclosed.

timeline.title: First dollar of revenue
timeline.detail: Real money received. The only metric that counts.

timeline.title: Benchmark beaten: > $0.06
timeline.detail: The previous run's total profit, exceeded.
